scoring_justification: Critical exponent ratios are recomputed from raw maxima via finite-size scaling regression and scored against paper's reported values with monotonic policy; phase diagram points coordinates compared to paper's gold with tolerance; topology checked structurally.

hidden_assets.purpose: Provide reference exponent ratios and special points coordinates for verification
hidden_assets.source_provenance: Paper Table 1 and Figure 2; values extracted from paper text.
hidden_assets.generation_method: Manual extraction from paper's reported numbers.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: These are the paper's actual reported quantities for the model and simulations, exactly as published.

outputs.description: Maximum specific heat values and the temperatures at which they occur for every simulated (N, μ) pair. The checker will recompute critical exponent ratio α/ν from these maxima using finite-size scaling.

Maximum susceptibility values and the temperatures at which they occur for every simulated (N, μ) pair. The checker will recompute critical exponent ratio γ/ν from these maxima using finite-size scaling.

Points on the T–Θ phase diagram boundaries (critical lines, coexistence boundaries, and special points) determined from the N=96 simulations. The checker will compare the coordinates of the labeled tricritical, eutectic, and critical points to the paper-reported values within a tolerance, and verify the presence of required coexistence regions.

output_contract.notes: All three scored files are essential to verify the paper's main claim that the minimal lattice-gas model reproduces the experimental phase diagram. The checker does not rely on any self-reported metrics; it recomputes exponent ratios from the raw maxima and directly compares boundary-point coordinates.

steps.description: Recomputes critical exponent ratio alpha/nu from specific heat maxima for mu ~ -1.14 and mu ~ -0.75, scores closeness to paper values.
Recomputes critical exponent ratio gamma/nu from susceptibility maxima for mu ~ -1.14 and mu ~ -0.75, scores closeness to paper values.
Extracts tricritical, eutectic, and critical point coordinates from phase diagram points and compares to paper gold with absolute tolerance.
Verifies presence of required boundary types (critical, coexistence_left/right, tricritical, eutectic) and that phase boundary coverage spans Theta 0.05–0.33.
